Each recording now shows its status in the queue. A green checkmark stays beside completed recordings after the batch finishes. If a batch stops early, the queue identifies completed, failed, cancelled, and incomplete recordings. In a multi-model benchmark, a recording earns its checkmark after the final model finishes.

Download **Transcriber-1.3.1-macOS-arm64.zip** for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Unzip it and move Transcriber.app to Applications.
